title: WEIGHTED_BASIS_FUNCTIONAL_ALLTRUE
selected_statement: For X : Profinite, L : LocallyConstant X ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ, and v : LocallyConstant X ℤ, weightedBasisBooleanPairing X (fun i => L (integralBasis X i)) v (fun _ => true) = L v.
proof_route: View all-true evaluation of the weighted Boolean pairing as a linear functional in v.
Use Module.Basis.repr_self on each basis vector.
Unfold the weighted Boolean linear combination.
Evaluate the unique basis coordinate at the all-true selector to obtain L (integralBasis X i).
Conclude equality of linear functionals and evaluate at arbitrary v.
falsification_requirement: A refutation must exhibit concrete protected-type X, L, and v for which the selected equality fails. Abstract additive toy models are not sufficient.
next_if_proved: Specialize to measurePointIntegralFunctional and finiteDeltaPullbackR, materialize finite all-true coefficient reconstruction, transport through protected finite measure isomorphisms and the quotient limit, then prefer the weakest d-applied compatibility sufficient to prove d.hom.app (op Point) = 0.
claim_boundary: Selection only. No N2 theorem, finite-stage reconstruction, global weighted coverage, Point-component vanishing, d=0, mapping-out injectivity, coefficient solidity, P3 completion, or CM4 completion is admitted.
